summary: The miniature has a coherent, charming cabin/studio style: compact one-storey massing, simple gable, pale roof, reddish-brown walls, cream trim, and restrained openings. No major silhouette or rendering defects are apparent, but the principal entrance is not verifiable from the supplied evidence.

orientation.summary: The actual model has one principal door on the -v/NE face (55°). The only located street view approaches from the SW and geometrically faces the +v/SW face; vegetation heavily obscures the building and does not reveal the opposite -v face or establish an entrance. The north-up aerial and map establish footprint orientation but show no readable doorway. Thus the -v placement is neither confirmed nor contradicted; importantly, West Lake Road proximity does not prove that +v is the entrance.

issues.problem: Principal-entry placement on the -v/NE face remains unsupported, so orientation cannot be approved.
issues.fix: Provide a located view or other supplied visual evidence showing the NE face and entrance, then retain or relocate the model’s single principal portal accordingly; do not add a second principal door merely to hedge.
